episodes.title: Hold Those Horses!
episodes.summary: The girls arrive at Carson Estate for a weeklong stay with Ken's wealthy aunt. But on their very first night, a prized horse and saddle go missing.

episodes.title: Taking the Reins
episodes.summary: Everyone's a suspect, so the Barbies hunt for clues to clear their names. Are Lady Puddington's muddy shoes a sign of guilt — or just a fashion crime?

episodes.title: Veering Off Course
episodes.summary: Denholm seems awfully suspicious... until Lady Carson reveals she might have a motive. Ken and Marcus arrive in London. Cassidy makes an unexpected move.

episodes.title: One Horse Fashion Show
episodes.summary: Brooklyn and Malibu follow Cassidy to Venice, where they're pulled into a fashion-forward side quest and reunite with an old friend.

episodes.title: As Good as Gondola
episodes.summary: The teen detectives split up into three different groups: one to find Pepper, one to track down Dietrich, and one to keep an eye on Giovanni.

episodes.title: Back in the Diamond Saddle
episodes.summary: Surprising confessions come to light as Brooklyn and Malibu team up to protect precious cargo aboard a speeding train headed back to England.

episodes.title: Down to the Wire
episodes.summary: With the competition looming and Pepper still on the loose, the Carsons need another horse — and someone to ride her. The gang sets a trap for Giovanni.

episodes.title: Jumping to Conclusions
episodes.summary: The Barbies have a plan to rescue the horses, recover the saddle and win the championship, too. But it'll take everyone on the team to pull it off!

episodes.title: Beach Bash Begins
episodes.summary: Magic's in the air as Brooklyn and Malibu seek out a juicy new story for their hit podcast while starting summer jobs with pals Ken, Marcus and Nikki.

episodes.title: How the Crystal Ball Bounces
episodes.summary: Who swiped Martin the Magnificent's crystal? The Barbies consider their suspects while investigating why Madame Celeste is acting even odder than usual.

episodes.title: Now You See Her
episodes.summary: The plot thickens as the Barbies suspect summertime sabotage. Meanwhile, Ken finds a clue, Councilman Wynin comes clean and Warlock has a rough night.

episodes.title: Welcome to the Fun House
episodes.summary: Zoe's gone missing, and the mysteries are really piling up. Hoping to uncover some clues, the Barbies attend auditions to be Warlock's new assistant.

episodes.title: Girls Just Wanna Have Sun
episodes.summary: There's a ghostly green glow coming from the sea caves, then suddenly... it's gone. Later, a bitter feud between Warlock and MC D-Dub explodes on stage.

episodes.title: The Legend of the Acceletrix
episodes.summary: After the legendary Malibu Moondial is stolen, the Barbies are totally stuck — until they realize they may have overlooked a prime suspect.

episodes.title: Spell Bound
episodes.summary: A close call at the caves leads to a major breakthrough in the case. But to bring down a criminal mastermind, Brooklyn and Malibu will need backup.

episodes.title: A Real Showstopper
episodes.summary: As the gang races against time to stop the culprit, a shocking revelation turns the entire investigation upside-down.
